statement:
∀ (n : ℕ),
  0 < n → ∀ (a : ℤ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Complex.exp (↑(2 * π * ↑a * ↑k / ↑n) * Complex.I) = if ↑n ∣ a then ↑n else 0

goal.text: ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Complex.exp (↑(2 * π * ↑a * ↑k / ↑n) * Complex.I) = if ↑n ∣ a then ↑n else 0
goal.lhs: ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Complex.exp (↑(2 * π * ↑a * ↑k / ↑n) * Complex.I)

atoms: ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Complex.exp (↑(2 * π * ↑a * ↑k / ↑n) * Complex.I)
